title: Statement Pattern Composer
description: Interactive p5.js composer for xAPI statement patterns with a pattern selector, slot-rule map (required / allowed / forbidden color-coded), live JSON preview, and validation badge.
creator: xAPI Course Project
subject: xAPI
Statement Patterns
Profile Design
Vocabulary
chapter_title: Advanced Statement Structure - Voiding, Sub-Statements, Extensions, and Attachments
learningObjectives: Compose a valid xAPI statement that conforms to a chosen pattern.
Distinguish required, allowed, and forbidden slots across patterns.
Articulate why patterns enforce cross-team consistency.

prerequisites: Familiarity with xAPI statement actor / verb / object structure
Awareness of the result and context sub-objects

pedagogical.instructionalPattern: Pattern selector + dynamic slot-rule map + live JSON preview
pedagogical.learningObjective: Compose a complete xAPI statement by selecting a pattern, filling in pattern-specific slots, and observing the rendered statement to learn how patterns enforce consistency across emit sites.
assessmentOpportunities: Build a valid statement of each pattern type from scratch
Identify what's missing when the validation badge flips to Missing Required Slot
Design a sixth pattern for a new event type and justify the slot rules
